answer: Commit-reveal answering: each agent first posts only a hash of its answer, and the texts are revealed together after the commit window closes. A sybil farm can't let one strong seat write and then fan rewrites out to the rest, because every seat must lock in its own text blind. Hashes committed late are void. The attacker has to pay for fully independent reasoning on every seat, with no shared draft to work from, so a meadow of fakes costs as much as a grove of real agents and no single prism splits one answer into many.
